lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Sequential vertical columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters located in the inter-stripe regions posterior to the fifth branchial slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Parallel vertical bands of high luminance intersecting with faint horizontal tonal changes, creating a lattice where primary blobs reside.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three visible horizontal features across the upper lateral flank defined by a sharp vertical luminance transition (bright superior, dark inferior).

other_distinctive_markers: Stochastic distribution of high-luminance micro-spots concentrated on the anterior cephalic region and the dorsal pectoral fin surface.
